kjv: verily every man at his best state [is] altogether vanity (KJV 39:5)
mine: Surely all mankind stands as a mere breath
note: 'akh kol-hevel kol-'adam nitsav: hevel is "breath, vapour" (transience rather than moral vanity), and nitsav "standing (firm)" means even the person who seems secure; the KJV's "at his best state" paraphrases nitsav well, but "vanity" now suggests conceit.

kjv: O spare me, that I may recover strength (KJV 39:13)
mine: Look away from me, that I may smile again
note: hasha' mimmenni "look away from me" (cf. Job 7:19, 14:6) is a plea that God stop scrutinising him; we'avligah "that I may brighten up".
